## Legal gate

For every **yes**, link the updated register or explain why the existing entry covers it.

- [ ] New personal data field, use, retention period, or recipient? Update `docs/legal/data-map.yaml` and the public notice when needed.
- [ ] New third-party host, script, SDK, or processor? Update `docs/legal/vendor-register.md` and check browser requests.
- [ ] New safety, privacy, performance, payment, token, or removal claim? Add evidence and owner in `docs/legal/claims-register.md`.
- [ ] New or changed email? Classify it, verify sender/postal address, opt-out, suppression, and update `docs/legal/email-operations.md`.
- [ ] New runtime dependency, bundled asset, or brand mark? Update license register and notices; record rights evidence.
- [ ] Terms, Privacy, or Cookie Policy changed? Add a versioned snapshot, effective date, `docs/legal/legal-document-changelog.md` entry, and `docs/legal/attorney-packet.md` review row.
